nodes.name: Build check · Hatchery First: 17 Hatch 17 Gas 17 Pool
nodes.description:
Your opening compared with the build order guide "Hatchery First: 17 Hatch 17 Gas 17 Pool" for Zerg vs Protoss. It covers the first 3:00 of the game.
Suggested: you did not name a build order guide, so we used the one closest to your opening.
By supply: this build order guide gives supply counts, not times, so each step is compared by the supply you were on when you started it. A step marked ≈ is one where we know your supply only roughly.

7 steps in the build order guide: 4 on supply · 1 done · 1 late · 1 missing (1 done later, 1 partly made).
2 Queens: you made 1 of the 2 in time, and the other later, at 9:48.
Extra, not in the build order guide: 1 Queen, 1 Hatchery.
Counted, not graded: 24 Drones, 6 Zerglings.

Patch unknown: the build order guide does not say which patch it was written for (last edited 2018-01-12), so some timings may have changed since. Most community build orders carry this note.

Source: Liquipedia, "Hatchery First (Legacy of the Void)", revision 1258135, https://liquipedia.net/starcraft2/Hatchery_First_(Legacy_of_the_Void). Text by Liquipedia contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 3.0. We turned it into steps.

8 steps in the build order guide: 6 on supply · 1 done · 1 a bit late.
